paragraphs: I am Sam, and I live in a small town. Come and see the center of my town. There is a big circle of grass and flowers. A tall clock stands in the circle. Four buildings are around the circle. Dad and I often sit on the grass there. We look at the people and the buses. It is a nice place.

The cinema is a big white building. It is opposite the library. The library is a small yellow building. It has many books. I read there on the weekend. The bus stop is in front of the library. The market is next to the cinema. You can buy fruit, fish, and eggs there. Behind the market there is a small shop for noodles. Where do I eat noodles? I eat noodles at the shop.

Look at the sky behind the buildings. You can see a green mountain. The mountain is very big. It is green, and the sky is blue. At night, the moon is above the mountain. The lamps in the circle are yellow. Dad says, "This is the best place in town." I think so, too.
text.summary: Sam describes the center of his town and says where the cinema, the library, the market, and the mountain are.
